aluminum_melting_2.name: Melting of Aluminum - Level 2
aluminum_melting_2.description: Simulate the melting of Aluminum by heating under NPT conditions using the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential. The simulation should replicate the system by 3 times in each direction. Use the partial radial distribution function (RDF) to determine the Al–Al bond length after melting. Report the bond length corresponding to the first RDF peak in Å.
